_: The wall. Edit this, then run: node tools/build-wall.js  (it rewrites #wall in index.html and refuses a ragged wall). Sizes: wide 2x1, wide3 3x1, tall 1x2, lg 2x2, wx 1x3 (weather), none = 1x1. A tile is {game, title} | {photo, img, alt, title, label?} | {html: partial name in wall/partials/}.
